messages:
leila: Quick heads-up — finished shadow runs for model v2p2-int4. High level: ~10% token cost reduction and ~55% throughput improvement on p4-small, but a small regression on long-doc MRR: baseline 78.4 -> v2p2 76.6 (-1.8 abs). Hallucination rate on 'legal' slice +0.7% abs. Tail latency p99 +2ms. Should we gate? :thinking_face:
omar: can you drop the slice breakdown? which cohorts are most affected?
leila: paste below (short): 
- general: delta MRR -0.3 abs
- long-docs (>8k tokens): delta MRR -1.8 abs
- code-snips: +0.1 abs
- legal: hallucination +0.7 abs (stat sig at p=0.02)

nina: thanks — p=0.02 is borderline but concerning for legal. Do we have CI on long-doc MRR? how many samples?
leila: long-doc N=4200, 95% CI delta [-2.4, -1.2].
shawn: that CI is pretty clear. My vote: block automated promotion above 5% traffic until we tighten quantization kernel or run a targeted long-doc burn-in.
omar: agreed. Might be an interaction with KV-cache warmup — int4 seems to impact prefix coherency for long contexts. Can we run a targeted shadow with warmed KV?
leila: scheduled a warm-kv shadow now (1h run) and a 5k-sample synthetic long-doc fuzz test.
eval-bot: eval job created: id=ev-175432-01. Metrics tracked: MRR, hallucination_rate, exact_match, latency_p95/p99. Link: https://internal/evals/ev-175432-01
shawn: propose rollout canary config (draft):
```yaml
canary:
  phases: [0.01, 0.05, 0.2]     # 1% -> 5% -> 20% over ~3h
  min_samples_per_phase: 2000
  metrics:
    mrr: {relative_threshold_pct: -1.0, absolute_threshold: -0.5, direction: decrease}
    hallucination_rate: {absolute_threshold: +0.3, direction: increase}
  significance: {alpha: 0.05, method: bootstrap}
  auto_fallback:
    enabled: true
    trigger: any_metric_exceeds_threshold
    min_consecutive_windows: 2
    cooldown: 30m
```
nina: two comments: 1) use both absolute and relative thresholds for MRR (long-docs often have smaller absolute numbers but big relative impact). 2) require at least one metric with >2000 samples AND p<0.05 before auto-fallback to avoid noisy early stops.
omar: add a soft-degrade route: if hallucination breaches but MRR holds, divert 50% of canary traffic to v2p2 with extra rerank (cheaper workaround) rather than full rollback.
sre-bot: note — routing rule added to draft: 
```
route: {name: "v2p2-soft-degrade", weight: 0.5, modifiers: [rerank_high_confidence]}
```
leila: action items: 1) finish warm-kv shadow (me), 2) run targeted long-doc burn-in (me), 3) implement canary config with N=2k min samples + CI (shawn), 4) prepare soft-degrade route (omar). I'll wait for eval-bot results before promoting to dedicated canary.
shawn: TL;DR — blocking automated promote until long-doc CI narrows or delta < 0.5 abs. manual small-fraction canary ok with rerank soft-degrade. :thumbsup:
leila: thanks all — will post ev-175432-01 summary here when complete. :white_check_mark:
